units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 20:18">Targ. Job XX, 18</cite> Ms.
<cite ref="Shevuot 17b:3">Shebu. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>אי דלא הפיך ביה לא מִיעַכֵּל</he> (v. Ms. M. in D. S. a. l. note) if without turning it, the sacrifice had not been consumed.

<cite ref="Shevuot 17b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אי לא הפיך בהו מִיעַכְּלֵי … מיעכל בהד שעתא</he> if he had not turned them (the pieces), they would have been consumed in two hours, and now all of it was consumed in one hour.
